q: How does a Marmara grinding unit count imported clinker in CBAM?
title: Grinding units: imported clinker in CBAM
short: Clinker is a precursor. Add tonnes of clinker used times its producer's verified embedded emissions, or the default value for its origin, to your own grinding electricity, then divide by tonnes of cement. Clinker usually decides most of the figure.
audience: Cement grinding units in Turkey's Marmara region that buy clinker from other plants or abroad

ol: Clinker used x the clinker's specific embedded emissions, direct and indirect.
Your grinding electricity x the applicable electricity factor.
Any fuel burnt on site, such as for slag drying.
Divide the total by tonnes of cement produced.

p: Request its verified direct and indirect emissions per tonne of clinker for the same period. Without them, the default value for the supplier's country applies.
Slag, fly ash and limestone added at grinding carry little process CO2. Record tonnes so the clinker share is clear.
